pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five industry groups with record bookings ($59.3B in FY21); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Accenture's own FY2021 10-K names off-shore providers, 'off-shore IT service providers in lower-cost locations, particularly in India', among its competitors and says competitors 'may be willing, at times, to take on more risk or price contracts lower than us' and 'may also offer more aggressive contractual terms', and that its global delivery capability 'is concentrated in India and the Philippines', while its own global delivery capability has 'large portions' based in India and the Philippines (no delivery headcount or center count given; the FY2016 10-K counted about 285,000 people). The stock trades at 26.7x FY22E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (OFFSHORE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing offshore substitution for ACN specifically.

Live: Accenture's own FY2021 10-K says 'Examples of areas of significant change include digital-, cloud- and security-related offerings, which are continually evolving, as well as developments in areas such as artificial intelligence, augmented reality, automation, blockchain, Internet of Things, quantum and Edge computing, infrastructure and network engineering, intelligent connected products, digital engineering and manufacturing, and as-a-service solutions. ... Some of these technological developments have reduced and replaced some of our historical services and solutions and may continue to do so in the future.' At the same time it reports 'growing demand to assist clients with application modernization and maintenance, cloud enablement and managed security services'. The stock trades at 26.7x FY22E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of ACN's outsourcing specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five industry groups with record bookings ($59.3B in FY21); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.70x; +48% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.07; conservative 2yr +24%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY11-FY21, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (FY11-FY21 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY21); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2022-06-10) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.70x (36.7% downside to Bear $181 / +52.8% upside to Bull $437) | Adj composite 3.40 vs market 2.33: gap +1.07 [UNDERVALUED] | +48% above the EPP floor $193 (18x FY22E $10.71) | Conservative 2-yr case: +23.8% total (+11.9%/yr) | At 26.7x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $378 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; consulting +34% LC in Q2, Q3 guided +22-26% LC; offshore competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
